bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: International standard ISO 16 fixes concert pitch A4 above middle C at 440 hertz, and every octave above doubles the fundamental frequency.
core_mechanism_bullets: International standard ISO 16 fixes concert pitch A4 above middle C at 440 hertz, and every octave above doubles the fundamental frequency.
Acoustic timbre arises from the relative amplitude of integer harmonic overtones generated by vibrating strings, air columns, membranes, and plates.
